programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Tout le monde à Fraisi-Paradis a hâte de découvrir qui gagnera le Festival des fleurs du printemps cette année ! La ville est décorée de bannières colorées annonçant le grand événement. C'est Mimi Citron qui a travaillé le plus dur....

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.sub-title: Une baby-sitter qui en voit de toutes les couleurs
programme.desc: Les amies de Charlotte aux fraises la regardent, les yeux écarquillés, verser une couche de smoothie aux myrtilles dans un grand verre, très délicatement, essayant de ne pas perturber les cinq autres couches multicolores en-dessous. C'est la...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est une journée bien remplie pour Mimi Citron. Son salon de coiffure est un endroit charmant et c'est l'un des endroits préférés de Charlotte et de ses amies pour se détendre et se retrouver. Toutes les filles y sont pour se faire coiffer...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Baba Hortensia a commandé des graines de marguerite spéciales et les a plantées dans son jardin. Elle est surprise de voir qu'elles ont poussé en moins d'une journée, malgré la description qu'il en est fait à cet effet sur le paquet....

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Charlotte se rend au magasin de Fleur d'oranger pour envoyer une carte d'anniversaire à un ami à Métropomme. Juste après qu'elles aient déposé la carte dans la fente de la boîte aux lettres, une abeille porteuse éternue et envoie des...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle répète une chanson seule dans son café, Charlotte est interrompue par l'arrivée de Mademoiselle Nelle. La pauvre coccinelle est stressée par l'annonce de l'arrivée imminente de ses nièces jumelles, qui viennent lui rendre...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Au magasin général de Fleur d'oranger pour récupérer un colis, Petit Pépin l'ancien discute avec elle du bâton sauteur qu'il lui a donné pour l'aider à atteindre les étagères les plus hautes. Elle lui en est très reconnaissante. Il...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Prunetille, ayant décidé d'organiser un spectacle de danse au Café Cabaret de Charlotte, envoie une pile d'invitations. Mais elle a oublié de vérifier la feuille d'inscription du salon de thé et programme le spectacle le soir même où Baba...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Toute la ville de Fraisi-Paradis est rassemblée pour regarder fondre le dernier petit-pépin de neige. Alors que la dernière couche de neige se transforme en flaque d'eau, une acclamation se fait entendre : le printemps est arrivé ! C'est...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Charlotte ouvre sa porte et découvre une foule de Petits-Pépins qui l'acclament, elle, la nouvelle Fraisi-Princesse du Printemps. Si elle apprécie leur admiration, elle n'est pas bien sûre de savoir en quoi consistent ses fonctions. Les...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Tout le monde à Fraisi-Paradis est occupé à la recherche de la mystérieuse baie voyageuse. Elle doit servir de dessert au Grand Festival du Printemps. Alors que tout le monde est parti chercher seul dans son coin, Baba Hortensia fait remarquer...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: En entendant Baba Hortensia lire une histoire sur l'effrayant Crapoteur géant aux Petits-Pépins, Fleur d'oranger est contre toute attente secouée. Elle décide qu'elle ne veut rien d'effrayant autour d'elle, elle veut juste se détendre. Mais...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Baba Hortensia est obsédée par Patty Persimmone, une héroïne de romans policiers. Elle décore son magasin avec des posters de Patty, réarrange ses rayons pour faire place à tous les livres de Patty qu'elle a commandés, se met à négliger...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Au beau milieu d'une démonstration de décoration de gâteaux au café, les amies se font inhabituellement interrompre par la Princesse Fraisinette, surexcitée. Elle leur annonce que la vieille tradition du derby de Fraisi-Paradis va être...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Le bois de Fraisi-Paradis est en pleine effervescence. Les Petits-Pépins récoltent des baies avec leurs étincelles, Petit Pépin l'ancien est dans son jardin à arroser ses fleurs avec une solution spéciale pour les faire grossir, et Lili...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est à nouveau l'heure de la compétition de danse de Fraisi-Paradis ! Prunetille est stressée et exténuée : elle veut absolument gagner ! Mais ses adversaires sont redoutables. Elles sont élégantes et synchronisées à merveille....

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles sont toutes réunies au café. Charlotte essaie de faire de la compote de pommes maison à l'aide d'un maillet (et fait en fait plein de cochonneries), tandis que les autres sont occupées à fabriquer leurs propres papiers cadeaux et...

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Rien-Ne-Sert prétend être un grand magicien capable de faire disparaître la lune. Mais quand des objets commencent à disparaître autour de lui, ses amis pensent qu'il perd le contrôle de ses pouvoirs. Lulu va l'aider à prouver son innocence. Ensuite, lors d'un jeu, Rien-Ne-Sert et Lulu sont jugés mauvais joueurs. Qui l'est le plus ? Une affaire difficile à trancher !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: La maîtresse a lancé la réélection d'un responsable de classe. Lulu, candidate sortante, pense être réélue haut la main mais Rien-Ne-Sert décide de se présenter. Une petite « campagne électorale » se met en place…Parce qu'il est le plus petit du groupe et se sent isolé, Ni-Oui s'invente un nouvel ami. Chacun réagit à sa façon à cet « étranger » et tout le monde en tire une leçon d'amitié.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Dans la bande, Blaise est le grand qui n'a peur de rien et Ni-Oui le petit qui a peur de tout. Mais un gros orage va nous montrer que les choses ne sont pas si simples.Frou-Frou pense être amoureuse de Chante-Faux et Lulu l'aide à se déclarer par le biais d'un mot d'amour. Mais la déclaration s'égare, ce qui provoque des malentendus dans le groupe de copains.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Poulenstein, monstre-poulet rejeté, gagne la confiance du poulailler grâce à sa soupe d'orties. Quand il perd un boulon, il devient fou, mais Carmen et Carmélito le réparent. Heureux, il est enfin accepté. Pendant ce temps, Hercule, manipulé par Rattila, capture Carmen et Carmélito, mais Bélino et Hercule sauvent la situation en chassant les rats.

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Carméla pond un œuf en or, ce qui suscite jalousie. Rattila la kidnappe pour ses œufs d'or, mais Carmen, Carmélito et Bélino la sauvent. Plus tard, Carmen est enlevée par un yéti solitaire. Carmélito et Bélino le raisonnent grâce à une plante hypnotique, l'hypnoficus, et ramènent Carmen au poulailler.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Paon, narcissique, se fait défigurer en se faisant couper ses plumes. Qui ? La Grue, Mme Hippopotame ou la Mouffette ? Pendant ce temps, Sherlock veut suivre la finale de cricket mais doit enquêter. Mme Hippopotame découvre son dentifrice remplacé par du gel moussant. Sherlock déteste les rumeurs, mais Hermine en lance une sur lui !

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Lion a admis la Mouffette dans un club réservé aux félins moustachus. Un membre mécontent a trafiqué la perruque du Lion pour la rendre féminine. Sherlock et Hermine se disputent sur la parité, Hermine veut enquêter seule. Pendant ce temps, un admirateur graffe Hermine dans le zoo. Sherlock, lui, se vante d'être expert en séduction.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Marcus tombe sous le charme de Kenza, une nomade victime d'un incendie, ce qui inquiète Ephi et Gratrok. Ils doivent aussi s'occuper d'un bébé Crokie intenable et l'amener à sa mère sans le faire pleurer, sinon des fleurs carnivores poussent. Vipkrad kidnappe le bébé pour tricher, et la jalousie de Gratrok complique tout.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Les petits Debings, capturés par Vipkrad, sont condamnés aux mines de Chokobongo. Marcus doit les guider à la surface pour obtenir un fragment de miroir. Mais les Debings, naïfs, lui causent bien des soucis. Marcus décide de leur apprendre à devenir "grands". Puis, au Grand Hôtel des Mers MacManaman, Marcus enquête sur un vol et soupçonne Vipkrad… mais se pourrait-il qu'il soit innocent ?

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon écrase la grenade de Pétunia et tente de traverser l'île pour en cueillir une autre, mais son périple tourne vite au parcours du combattant ! . Chargé de garder Tatouwak, il lui donne du chocolat, provoquant une folle course-poursuite. Pour finir un puzzle, il risque tout en entrant dans la caravane. Devenu gardien de l'île, son « code » trop strict embête tout le monde !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: La taupe offre un jeu vidéo à Grabouillon pour qu'il se calme, mais il devient obsédé. En peignant, Grabouillon salit le camp, alors il fait nettoyer Tatouwak à sa place, mauvaise idée ! Bagou se moque avec sa raquette, Grabouillon apprend des acrobaties pour la récupérer. Pour éviter l'Aloe Vera, il simule une allergie avec l'aide de Bagou.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon participe au concours de pizza, triche et complique la vie de ses amis, mais ça pourrait se retourner contre lui. En l'absence de Pétunia, il vide le réservoir d'eau et tente de le remplir avant son retour. Il prête sa voiture cassée à Bagou, qui la répare et refuse de la rendre. Avec des lunettes magiques, Grabouillon croit devenir un géant, mais c'est compliqué.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon feint la fièvre pour éviter une corvée, mais Cunégonde le surveille et l'enferme. Il creuse un tunnel pour s'échapper, mais les ennuis continuent. Avec Bagou, il reçoit du courrier plein de secrets. Après avoir vexé Cunégonde en l'imitant, il tente de se faire pardonner. Leur cerf-volant reste coincé dans un arbre, et l'ascenseur à poulie se bloque.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon met un piment dans sa trottinette et fonce trop vite. Ses amis lui lancent un défi : une course autour de l'île, sinon il perd sa trottinette. Gonzague organise un concours d'abris pour oiseaux. Grabouillon, mauvais bricoleur, se fait aider en secret. Jaloux d'Anowak, il hésite à plonger du haut d'un rocher.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E21 Pingu et le papier mâché | Pingu a mal au ventre | Pingu s'emballe
programme.desc: S2:E21 Pingu et le papier mâché | Pingu a mal au ventre | Pingu s'emballe - Le professeur de Pingu montre à la classe comment fabriquer des formes en papier mâché, et Pingu et ses amis sont impressionnés. | Pingu ne peut pas se passer de ses en-cas au poisson préférés. | Papa donne une leçon de conduite à Pingu, mais Pingu casse accidentellement le levier de vitesse.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E22 Pingu et le magasin de jouets | Pingu et l'animal de l'école | Pingu chouchouté
programme.desc: S2:E22 Pingu et le magasin de jouets | Pingu et l'animal de l'école | Pingu chouchouté - Pingu veut un nouveau jouet, mais maman refuse de lui en acheter lors de leurs courses. | Pingu est chargé de s'occuper de l'animal de compagnie de l'école. C'est un crabe grincheux qui n'aime pas Pingu. | Pingu sème le chaos lorsqu'il est obligé d'accompagner maman au salon de beauté.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E23 Pingu s'emmitoufle | Pingu et la flûte en poisson | Pingu jaloux
programme.desc: S2:E23 Pingu s'emmitoufle | Pingu et la flûte en poisson | Pingu jaloux - Quand Pinga se cogne l'orteil, Pingu s'amuse beaucoup à bander son pied douloureux et à la faire rire. | Pingu trouve une flûte magique, mais personne ne semble apprécier ses bruits stridents... sauf les poissons ! | Pingi semble préférer jouer avec Pingo plutôt qu'avec Pingu.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E24 La grosse prise de Pingu | Pingu et les bretelles | Pingu et l'igloo quotidien
programme.desc: S2:E24 La grosse prise de Pingu | Pingu et les bretelles | Pingu et l'igloo quotidien - Pingu promet d'attraper un GROS poisson pour maman, mais aux trous de pêche, il ne remonte que des déchets ! | Pingu teste l'élasticité des bretelles de grand-père en courant jusqu'à être propulsé en arrière. | Pingu obtient un travail de distribution de journaux et est impatient de commencer.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E25 Pingu et la peinture | Pingu et la nouvelle trottinette | Pingu fait des vagues
programme.desc: S2:E25 Pingu et la peinture | Pingu et la nouvelle trottinette | Pingu fait des vagues - Pingu renverse de la peinture rouge, déclenchant un chaos incontrôlable alors qu'il essayait de peindre. | Pingu voit une nouvelle trottinette mais Pingg l'achète en premier ! | Pingu veut impressionner ses amis en plongeant, mais découvre que ce n'est pas si facile que ça !

programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie présentent les iCarly Awards. Ils récompensent en direct les auteurs des meilleurs contenus envoyés sur le site.

programme.title: Mélanie
programme.desc: Surprise, surprise ! Sam a une sœur jumelle appelée Mélanie. Et encore plus surprenant, elle est beaucoup plus féminine que Sam, et craque pour Freddie, qui la prend pour Sam déguisée.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: contre Dingo Channel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent qu'une émission de télé sur Dingo Channel plagie des contenus d'iCarly. Ils décident alors de se rendre à Los Angeles pour confronter les auteurs de l'émission.

programme.title: Laveu
programme.desc: Sous l'influence d'un gaz hilarant chez le dentiste, Sam parle à Carly de son baiser avec Freddie.

programme.title: Le concours de cuisine
programme.desc: Carly et Sam utilisent la recette de taco aux spaghettis de Spencer à l'occasion d'un concours télévisé avec un grand Chef.

programme.title: Le principal Franklin
programme.desc: Après que le Principal Franklin se soit fait renvoyer accidentellement à cause de Carly, Sam et Freddie, Mme Briggs et Mr Howard prennent le contrôle de l'école et instaurent des règles sévères ainsi qu'un code vestimentaire.

programme.title: Le bal des Demoiselles
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie organisent un speed dating afin de choisir celui qui accompagnera Carly à un bal. Pendant ce temps, Spencer suit un curieux régime.

programme.title: La Pop Star
programme.desc: Carly et ses amis tentent d'aider une ancienne pop star à réaliser la vidéo de son grand retour.

programme.title: Freddy, mon héros
programme.desc: Freddy sauve Carly qui était sur le point de se faire percuter par un camion. Elle tombe alors amoureuse de lui.

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: Gibby perd son sang froid
programme.desc: Gibby est persuadé que Freddie est intéressé par sa nouvelle petite amie. Il lui propose alors de le défier au cours d'un combat, que Sam décide de diffuser en direct dans l'émission de Carly.

programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Super-Vilains : La ligue des anti-héros
programme.desc: Dans un monde de super-vilains, les sbires font le sale boulot. Une nouvelle recrue rejoint l'équipe d'Hank, un homme de main blasé. Mais quand le Kid vole par erreur l'arme ultime, Hank doit enfreindre ses règles pour le sauver… quitte à devenir ce qu'il redoute : un héros.

programme.title: Cloudboy
programme.desc: Nila vient d'avoir douze ans, a toujours vécu en ville avec son père. Cet été, il se voit contraint de partir en vacances à la montagne dans le nord de la Suède avec sa mère qu'il ne connait presque pas.

programme.title: The Secret Kingdom
programme.desc: Dans un manoir, deux enfants découvrent un royaume magique et partent en quête pour sauver une civilisation menacée.

programme.title: Magic Kids
programme.desc: Trois adolescents, qui possèdent la capacité de se transformer en vampire, en fée et en loup-garou, intègrent une école de magie et affrontent des forces maléfiques.

programme.title: Dark Game
programme.desc: Un détective se lance dans une course contre la montre pour arrêter un jeu télévisé sur le dark web, où les captifs sont forcés de s'affronter pour rester en vie.

programme.title: Drone
programme.desc: Un pilote de drone expert qui travaille pour la CIA partage sa vie entre ses missions et sa vie de famille dans une petite ville de banlieue, jusqu'à ce qu'une fuite fasse de lui la cible d'un mystérieux homme d'affaires pakistanais.

programme.title: Death Kiss
programme.desc: Un justicier au passé mystérieux prend sous son aile une jeune mère et son enfant, tout en nettoyant une ville gangrénée par le crime et la peur.

programme.title: La Fureur d'une mère
programme.desc: Suite au meurtre de son fils avec qui elle n'entretenait plus de contact, une journaliste forme une alliance improbable avec la petite amie enceinte de ce dernier afin de traquer les responsables de sa mort, affrontant ensemble un monde de drogue et de corruption.

programme.title: Croisades
programme.desc: Au Moyen Âge, un croisé et son disciple aident l'héritier du trône menacé de mort à récupérer sa place légitime pour racheter leurs crimes.

programme.title: 5 est le numéro parfait
programme.desc: Un an après avoir surpassé le FBI, les 4 Cavaliers reviennent pour dénoncer un magnat criminel. Ignorant son piège, ils doivent braquer un système informatique sécurisé.

programme.title: Wildland
programme.desc: Après la mort de sa mère, Ida, 17 ans, emménage chez sa tante et ses fils. Tandis que la famille est aimante, elle mène une vie criminelle violente, et un meurtre met à l'épreuve leur loyauté.

programme.title: Taj Mahal
programme.desc: Louise a dix-huit ans lorsque son père doit partir à Bombay pour son travail. En attendant d'emménager dans une maison, la famille est d'abord logée dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace où une attaque terrorriste a lieu.

programme.title: Regarder Oana
programme.desc: Oana travaille. Et moi je la regarde. Ce soir, ce dernier dossier sera plié. Elle ne veut plus traduire les mots des autres. Elle pense que demain elle va commencer à écrire pour elle. Mais elle ne le fera pas. Je le sais....

programme.title: Bleu-Gris
programme.desc: Fin août. Corse. Elbe, dix-sept ans, sourde de naissance est en vacances chez sa grande sœur Mathilde. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au phare de la Revellata, elle aperçoit un homme qui remonte seul d'une plongée sous marine…

programme.title: Rase campagne
programme.desc: Un village perdu dans la campagne finistérienne. Un homme est suspecté d'être porteur du virus Ebola. Il est noir. C'est Maurice. Son meilleur ami, Michel, ambulancier, sillonne le territoire avec son stagiaire Rémi pour le retrouver et le contrôler…

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: John, un jeune bodybuilder, se prépare jour après jour pour une compétition, les NPC Georgia Bodybulding Championships. Sa vie est un rituel, une mécanique parfaitement réglée. Concentré sur son objectif, il ne lâche rien, espérant atteindre sur scène cet instant de bonheur unique : le flow.

programme.title: La femme à cordes
programme.desc: Sébastien, un jeune homme d'une vingtaine d'années, entre dans un petit théâtre sur les conseils d'un inconnu. Gogol l'invite à regarder son show. Ce dernier s'amuse à malmener une femme devant un parterre médusé. Sébastien s'interpose, sans connaître les règles du jeu.

programme.title: On the road...
programme.desc: « On the road to paradise » raconte la rencontre improbable dans un restoroute d'une serveuse au bord de la crise de nerfs, d'un camionneur collectionneur de routiers et d'une jeune femme en pleine rupture amoureuse. Tous les trois partagent sans le savoir, le même secret : ils viennent d'assassiner un homme. Un policier entre alors dans le restaurant...

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: L'Empire dévoile tout mais ne voit rien. Ses ennemis idéalisent tout mais ne tolèrent rien. L'orgasme terrestre des putains cathodiques pour les uns. L'orgasme éternel des 70 vierges paradisiaques pour les autres. Et si la chair était seule au monde ?

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: La Femme de Ménage
programme.desc: Pour se distraire d'une liaison une femme amoureuse se lie d'amitié avec une femme de ménage gravement brûlée. Elle apprend vite que ces cicatrices sont bien plus profondes que la surface.

programme.title: Java Heat
programme.desc: L'histoire se concentre sur les conséquences d'un attentat-suicide en Indonésie, où un Américain imprudent se faisant passer pour un étudiant diplômé cherche à se venger.

programme.title: Blonde en Béton
programme.desc: "Trois colocataires fauchées, la vingtaine, survivent de justesse dans un appartement délabré. Mais un soir, leur vie bascule lorsqu'elles découvrent une valise contenant trois millions de dollars, au beau milieu d'une scène sanglante après un règlement de comptes entre trafiquants de drogue. Tentées de garder l'argent et de fuir le pays, les filles se retrouvent vite prises en chasse par des criminels chevronnés bien décidés à récupérer leur butin. Elles devront alors faire face à un ultime affrontement… et se battre pour leur survie."

programme.title: L'Affaire CIA
programme.desc: Un ancien employé de CIA découvre un complot mortel tout en essayant de sauver sa fille qui a été enlevée.

programme.title: Imagine
programme.desc: Une rock-star vieillissante ne souhaite pas changer ses habitudes de vie, jusqu'à ce que son agent lui fasse ouvrir une lettre gardée secrète pendant 40 ans, écrite de la main de John Lennon, le célèbre membre des Beatles. Suite à cette découverte inattendue, Danny Collins va chercher à redécouvrir sa famille et à trouver l'amour.

programme.title: The Little Unicorn
programme.desc: Un conte de fées moderne vraiment enchanteur, avec des effets spéciaux époustouflants. La vie heureuse de la jeune Polly et de son grand-père est bouleversée par la mort de son cheval préféré et la naissance magique d'un bébé licorne dans leur ferme. Lorsque le village découvre son secret, certains de ses personnages les plus rusés tentent de voler la créature mystique.

programme.title: Princess In Love
programme.desc: L'histoire scandaleuse et véridique de la liaison entre le capitaine James Hewitt et Lady Diana Spencer, qui a détruit un mariage royal et stupéfié la monarchie britannique.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Clean, un homme au passé criminel, cherche la rédemption après avoir vécu une tragédie personnelle. Il dédie désormais sa vie à sa communauté délaissée et à la sécurité d'une jeune fille qui lui rappelle sa propre fille.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: Joe Gavilan et K.C. Calden sont tous deux inspecteurs à la brigade criminelle de Los Angeles. Suite à une étrange affaire de meurtre dans le milieu du rap, Joe et K.C. sont chargés de l'enquête et se voient contraints de collaborer en dépit de leurs personnalités diamétralement opposées...

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: L'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner et son beau-fils Trent s'infiltrent dans une école d'arts du spectacle pour filles après que Trent ait été témoin d'un meurtre.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Basée sur la célèbre bande dessinée Marvel, cette saga pleine d'action met en vedette Jennifer Garner dans le rôle d'Elektra, une guerrière-assassin qui participe à la bataille ultime entre le bien et le mal.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: Tard le soir de Noël, une femme qui sort seule du travail est enlevée par un agent de sécurité psychopathe qui a une obsession pour elle. Sans personne pour l'aider dans un parking immense, elle ne pourra compter que sur elle-même pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Une biographie de l'auteur de livres pour enfants Beatrix Potter racontant comment elle a affronté une mère autoritaire et le chauvinisme de l'Angleterre victorienne pour devenir l'auteur de best-sellers.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Au cours de l'été 2001, Tyler (Robert Pattinson), étudiant à New York, est encore bouleversé suite à la tragédie qui a altéré la relation avec son père lorsqu'il rencontre Ally (Emilie de Ravin), une fille qui comprend sa douleur. C'est une histoire inoubliable sur le pouvoir de l'amour, la force de la famille et l'importance de chérir ceux qu'on aime chaque jour de sa vie.

programme.title: Le complexe du castor
programme.desc: Cadre au travail, un mari en difficulté adopte une marionnette de castor comme seul moyen de communication.

programme.title: Le droit de tuer?
programme.desc: Après le viol de sa fille de dix ans par deux Blancs qui se croient au dessus de la loi, le père se fait justice en abattant les deux violeurs.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: La Ville fantôme est une comédie romantique pleine d'esprit(s) qui raconte l'histoire de Bertram Pincus, un dentiste irritable de Manhattan qui développe la capacité malencontreuse de voir les morts.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: Dans un monde post-apocalyptique, l'occupation est de trouver de la nourriture et des survivants.

programme.title: GBF
programme.desc: Alors que l'élection de la fille la plus populaire du lycée bat son plein, les candidates font l'impossible pour s'attirer les faveurs de Tanner, dont elles entendent faire leur Gay Best Friend.

programme.desc: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés, Michel et Michel vous disent tout sur vos films et séries préférés.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: L'Employeur
programme.desc: Cinq candidats s'affrontent dans une épreuve mortelle où un seul remportera le poste convoité.

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: VICE est un resort dans lequel les personnes peuvent assouvir leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Deux amis bientôt étudiants universitaires (Ansel Elgort et Chloë Grace Moretz) tombent amoureux l'un de l'autre. Mais après le meurtre mystérieux de leur camarade de classe, ils défient les autorités de découvrir la vérité.

programme.title: L'amour d'une mère
programme.desc: Mariée et mère de famille, Laney mène en apparence une vie paisible. Mais c'est sans compter sur la drogue, les rencontres avec d'autres hommes et son habitude de disparaitre sans prévenir.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: The Best Offer
programme.desc: Virgil Oldman, un expert en art reclus, acquiert des tableaux inestimables en trompant leurs propriétaires sur leur valeur. Engagé par la mystérieuse Claire Ibbetson pour évaluer son patrimoine, Virgil découvre des pièces mécaniques et demande l'aide de son ami Robert pour les réassembler.

programme.title: WELCOME BACK, MISS MARY
programme.desc: Joey Vitello, un jeune homme de vingt ans sans but, vit toujours chez ses parents au sein de sa famille italo-américaine haute en couleur. Il retrouve Mary O'Callahan, une camarade d'enfance autrefois surnommée Mary la Terrifiante . Celle qui était un vilain petit canard est devenue une beauté irrésistible, de retour dans le quartier après avoir vaincu un cancer. Lorsque Joey découvre que sa guérison est due à un miracle, leur amitié se transforme en romance, et Mary l'initie à la foi. Les nouvelles convictions de Joey bouleversent la foi de sa famille, et le chaos s'installe alors que chacun part à la recherche de son propre miracle.

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, peine à trouver le juste équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle se rend compte que la future construction d'un bâtiment ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques imprécises de la mairie.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Taylor Lorenz Interview
programme.desc: Taylor Lorenz is the journalist mapping out the culture of the internet and everything surrounding it. She discusses the growing power of the right in the online world, their ever-tightening grip on regulations of the internet and speech in the digital space, and how to fight back against it.

programme.title: Why Politics Doesn't Work Anymore
programme.desc: Author and Academic Anton Jäger discusses his book Hyperpolitics, examining contemporary political participation and the challenges facing progressive movements. He explores the decline of traditional party politics, the shift towards hyperpolitics where people are engaged but unorganised, and why the right has been more successful in building institutions. Jäger outlines issues with social media activism and presents approaches to creating a more collectivised political movement capable of challenging right-wing advances.

programme.title: Palantir: The UK Government's Single Point Of Failure
programme.desc: Martin Wrigley is one of the few MPs who understands the threat of big tech. Earlier this year told us about the growing influence of AI firm Palantir across the British state, from the NHS and the Ministry of Defence to the Cabinet Office. Starting with an off-the-books meeting between Boris Johnson, Dominic Cummings, and Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel, Wrigley argues that the US tech giant has steadily embedded itself at the heart of government while remaining largely unscrutinised. Wrigley questions whether parliament even understands what Palantir's systems are doing. From data collection and technical lock-in to lobbying and corporate influence, he asks whether Britain's increasing dependence on a single American company might leave the country vulnerable.

programme.title: Alex Horne vs FootballJOE Quiz
programme.desc: Taskmaster and comedy legend Alex Horne takes on a quiz testing his knowledge of comedians, football, hams, chickens and more, filmed at the Chesham United clubhouse. Alex is promoting his annual Comedy Football Trophy match taking place at Chesham United, featuring some of the biggest names in comedy playing for a great cause.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz

programme.title: Devina A.D.D. & The Relationship Virgin
programme.desc: It's a new week at the Millionaire's Club and that means two tough new clients for matchmaker, Patti Stanger. Author Devina Kaur is a sex crazed dating addict who's obsessed with hooking up with men on Craigslist. And Peter Curti, a gay millennial entrepreneur with his head buried in his phone, has never had a real relationship. Devina proves to be a challenge right out of the gate, matching Patti scream for scream. All of her outbursts leave Patti wondering if Devina has come to the Millionaire's Club just because she's run out of men on the internet. And when Patti throws a test into the mingle, Devina A.D.D. unsurprisingly fails miserably and earns a matchmaker punishment. It's a crap-shoot whether this wild and crazy Canadian will finally listen to Patti and find true love or revert to searching Craigslist for men. Meanwhile, relationship virgin Peter, is thrown into his love lesson. When confronted with his anti-social behavior, he argues with Patti, even telling her she's too old to understand. A generation gap Is obvious but Patti knows that dealing with millennials and their tech obsession requires an adjustment in tactics. Peter needs to learn to ditch his phone, pull his eyes up and learn to approach men like an alpha or he'll end up alone!

programme.title: Mr. Build-A-Girl and The Basketball Wife
programme.desc: This week it's a full-on, knock-down, drag-out fight between Patti Stanger and her two combative clients! Tough girl Basketball Wives LA tv star, Laura Govan, was majorly burned by her NBA star boyfriend of 17 years. Their nasty and highly publicized breakup left Laura alone with their four kids and with major trust issues. Patti's hidden cameras catch Laura in the act of some shocking behaviors that Laura uses to keep men away from her heart. If Laura wants to find a good man and potential stepfather to her four kids, she has to change her offensive deflecting behavior, or she'll remain single. Meanwhile, Bastian Yotta is obsessed with working out, his good looks and wants a woman who is equally as “perfect”. Patti calls Bastian out for being a “build-a-girl” after discovering that he will do will do anything to improve a woman's looks, even suggest and pay for their surgical enhancements. His superficial mentality prevents chemistry from taking over and Patti is forced give him one of her toughest reality checks ever to try and shake him of his perfectionism. At the mingle, it's Patti vs Bastian in a heated altercation after he insults the looks of one of her daters. And Laura and Bastian's dates go off the rails when one goes for a colon cleanse and the other instigates a private bikini fashion show. Both clients get the wrath of Patti, but will that be enough to help them get on the right path to true love?

programme.title: The Ageist and The Snob
programme.desc: Third generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever! She's taken over the exclusive Luxe Hotel in Bel-Air where she brings her toughest clients for a week-long lesson in love. This week, Patti is on the case with two tough lawyers: the ageist, David Goldman, and the first-class snob, Rhonda Wills. Right out of the gate, David jumps head first into a love lesson that he fails miserably when he ditches his age-appropriate date for a romp in the pool with a bunch of 20-somethings. Meanwhile, Patti struggles to convince Snobby Pants Rhonda to give up on her fairytale fantasy of Prince Charming. Patti, Candace, and Maxwell team up to find the perfect sexy singles for the mingle, but Patti throws the ageist David another curve ball when she adds a 22-year-old to the mix to test him. Will he fall for it and break Patti's rules or has he learned his lesson? Rhonda, on the other hand, meets a knight in shining armor. But… will she try to escape when he fails to deliver a fairytale first date. In the end, Patti's got a tough week. Will the lawyers learn their lesson or will it be a hung jury?

programme.title: The Wedding Planners 2
programme.desc: For some brides, it's not about budget—it's all about the bling.Bling on the Bride is a one-hour documentary where today's shiniest trends take center stage. Wedding consultant Tara Mandy and event planner Steve Kemble will discuss the latest trends and most innovative ways to add bling to any wedding. Jewelry is where it starts, from the traditional engagement rings of Tiffany & Co to the high-priced engagement rings worn by the hottest celebrities and the finest wedding jewelry creations of “designer to the stars” Neil Lane.You'll meet wedding cake designer Ron Ben-Israel, known for the edible bling that adorns his creations. And Mark Ingram will show you how the hottest wedding gown designers are using bling to make their hostesses shine. And you'll meet Brooke Webster and see the lengths she'll go to make her wedding day sparkle and why for her there's just never enough bling.

programme.title: Day of the Dead Bride
programme.desc: David can't helped but be creeped-out when this bride-to-be has wedding day visions that bring the Dawn of the Dead to mind? With Halloween far away on the calendar, David has his work cut out for him to make sure this wedding looks less like a vampire movie video and more like one of his elegant events. With a bride who has a lust for blood, can David create a wedding to remember without inspiring guests to run screaming from the celebration?

programme.title: Greek Goddess Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's next bride thinks her fiancé is a "Greek god," and what else would that mean, but a Greek themed wedding?! Instead of an elegant affair, the bride wants statues, golden centerpieces and a bridal party outfitted in white robes. David quickly decides to tread lightly with this bride. For him there's a fine line between the Dionysian elegance of the brides' dreams and what could end up looking like a fraternity toga party!

programme.title: Bling Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera knows that every bride wants to be a bright, shining star at her wedding, but when it comes to his new bride Joanne Oleary, he's going to have to come up with a new definition for “Bling!”. When Joanne explains that she's hoping for the ultimate bling wedding: glamour and sparkly fashion at every turn, with her as the diamond in the center, she challenges David to outdo her vision. But as David sees what Joanne has put together, he finds a mismatched mess: shoes on guest tables, sequined fabric for the walls, and flashlights stuck to the walls as makeshift lanterns. Over three weeks, David transforms Joanne's wedding into a nuclear explosion of blinged-out fabulousness! New dresses and jewelry for Joanne's bridesmaids, a sexy and elegant new gown for Joanne, and for a surprise that is sure to knock her socks off, Joanne and her girls get to star in their own professional fashion shoot!

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has a special gift that turns any bride's concept into an unforgettable, dramatic event. And when he meets bride Amber Fleener, who wants the ultimate “Phantom of the Opera” wedding, David knows he's the right man for the job. But instead of romance and drama, David finds that while Amber is hoping for a grand production of Phantom, what's she come up with is more like a high school play. With cheap costume masks and fake flowers that look like Christmas decorations, and a venue that's more suited for a block party, Amber is in dire need of David's help. Before she knows it, David is revising everything, giving her a stunning and dramatic new bridal gown, putting her bridesmaids in romantic, classic dresses, and changing the venue to one suitable for the huge production she's hoping for. David even gives Amber an unforgettable rehearsal dinner with family and friends before the big night!

Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.desc: Nepal is one of the poorest countries in the world. Young women are often disadvantaged here and quite a few are married off before the age of 18. Helicopter pilot Priya Adhikari lives and works here. The 38-year-old is an exception and the only woman in Nepal who ventures into the extremely dangerous heights of the Himalayas in her helicopter.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature's best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Pamban Railway crosses the tropical landscape of Tamil Nadu, the former Madras, for around 600 kilometers. Heavy storms and rain showers make the route a challenge for Indian Railways to this day. The film accompanies the "Rameswaram Express" over the notorious Pamban Bridge, the first bridge across the Indian Ocean.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: In northern Argentina, the world-famous Tren a las Nubes - the cloud train - crosses dizzying viaducts and deep valleys. At an altitude of over 4000 meters, what was once the highest railway runs past cactus forests and into the driest desert in the world. A technical feat in the Andes and a breathtaking ride through spectacular scenery.In northern Argentina, the world-famous Tren a las Nubes - the cloud train - crosses dizzying viaducts and deep valleys. programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Between Finland and Sweden
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea to this day. The third episode takes us to the Bay of Bothnia. More than double the size of the Netherlands, it is the most unknown region of the Baltic Sea. In the winter, the Baltic Sea freezes over at a length of 300 kilometres. In this 1-metre-thick ice tank, the third species of seal - alongside the grey seal and common seal - copes well with the Baltic Sea. The ringed seal is perfectly adapted to the Arctic winter and carves out breathing holes into the ice. More than 10,000 of the animals still live between Sweden and Finland. The Bay of Bothnia only has a salt content of just 1%, which is why it freezes quicker than other regions of the Baltic Sea. Many rivers disembogue here and “sweeten” the sea. The Tornio is the longest natural river in Europe. It forms the border between Sweden and Finland. Even when frost is severe, the Kukkolaforsen rapids in Sweden never freeze over, otters go hunting here. When it gets dark in the winter, solar winds conjure colourful light effects in the Baltic Sea sky. The Aurora Borealis can be seen in the northern regions of the Baltic Sea as of mid-October. The coast of Lapland is also the home of the reindeer. The Sami's, reindeer breeders, bring their herds in winter to the Baltic Sea, as the snow is not as deep here as it is further inland and the animals have better access to lichens and mosses. When Lapland's coast is still frozen, 300 kilometres further south in the Kvarken Archipelago, a special spectacle takes place. Millions of fish head for the coast. Barrier beaches prevent them from reaching the coastal lagoons. They can only spawn where the water is salt-free.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Video Wonder

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Octane and Trypticon conspire to help the greedy King Fakaddi.

programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them

The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.
